content:
We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (result of make_8_lvl2-template_search-3) to the molecule. We have the template ID 639229 and mapped_rxn given. We need to apply that template to the target molecule (which is from make_8_lvl2-apply_template-2 answer). That answer gave a list of lists: [["CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1S(=O)(=O)Nc1ccccc1F"]]. That's a single SMILES string (the product). So target molecule is that SMILES.

We need to apply template 639229 retrosynthetic to that molecule to get precursors. Use apply_template tool.

Let's call apply_template with molecule_smiles = that SMILES, template_id = "639229".
